posts.author: Stephanov
posts.title: Having the community learn.
posts.html:
With the help of my fellow administrators and the moderators.

We pulled of an event to instruct people on what is acceptable and inacceptable behaviour.

Hopefully, doing this like this can help future generations of community members to act more seriously and abide the rules.
